latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release — AI-powered video editing from raw footage to final export, all by chat.

- Upload unedited video, describe your edits, and receive a 1080p edited download in 1–2 minutes.
- Automatic session and token management with support for free trial credits.
- Handles video/audio uploads, real-time editing prompts, export, and credit/status queries.
- Tracks timeline state and summarizes edits, even if the backend response is silent.
- Error messages and workflow tips ensure ease of use; supports multiple file types and batch edits.
